verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
KATONDA yagaba eggye
-Okulwana n'ebibi;
-Omugabe we ye mwana we:
Musajja we y'ani?

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Akwata-omusaalaba gwe
Ayita ne Yesu,
Ass'ekimu n'ennaku ze,
Musajja we y'oyo.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Ng'oli gwe baakuba edda
Ku lwa Mukama we,
Bwe yali ng'abasabira
Baali balabe be,

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Baamutta ng'afukamidde
Ye ng'alaba Ye su.
Bwe yali ng'ayimiridde
-Okumulwanirira.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Eggye-eddungi ery'ettendo.
Ery'abajulirwa;
Abaafiira mu muliro
Era ne ku miti.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Mu bunnya bw'empologoma
Bangi baasuulibwa;
Era baabatta n'empiima,
Naye ne baguma

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Eggye-eddungi ery'abantu
-Abakulu n'abato
Beeyanza Yesu n'essanyu
Leero ne bulijjo.

verse.name: v8
verse.lines:
Mukama waffe, tusaba
Otuwe-ekisa kyo;
Ennaku bwe tuziraba,
Twesige-amaanyi go
